scope: Fixed recorded FFN proof evidence only; no captured code, Lean, model or GPU execution. This data reader adds no proof or original-paper result.

positive_fields.scope: Source-bound full-size compiled FP16 feed-forward development proof. Both actual parsed PTX programs (173 up-stage and 171 down-stage instructions), their prologues, all original 256/1024 reduction terms, ReLU and FP16 stores/loads, returns, all 65536 up-stage and 16384 down-stage lanes and all 16384 reference outputs are covered. The actual 65536-value FP16 intermediate connects the two stateful executions. The sequential host-launch model has explicit bijective root-buffer bindings, disjoint epoch namespaces, reverse-chronological actual access traces, race freedom and a frame outside intermediate/output footprints. The independent tensor reference interprets both matmuls, ReLU and both FP16 round trips. Original shapes, dtypes, grid/block/warp and CUDA fuel [1030,1,1,1]/[4102,1,1,1] remain unchanged. Scalar operations are universally quantified. Parsing/reference formalization, logical aligned disjoint non-wrapping pointer allocations, scalar-operation correspondence and sequential host-launch correspondence remain trusted. No IEEE/error-bound, NVIDIA execution/conformance, original optimized-kernel, original model-result or paper-completion claim. This separate development checker registers no legacy SDK profile or model success.

direct_fields.scope: Fresh source-only replay of the exact complete two-launch FFN proof. Two accepted-grammar PTX mutations traverse the actual frontend/render path. One direct reference-constructor mutation bypasses Python preflight. One direct host-composition source mutation disconnects the actual intermediate. All four must fail at the specified Lean proof, without resource failures or timeouts. Negative controls use only the just-source-built positive imports. Original shapes, launches, CUDA fuel and resource caps remain unchanged. These are proof-binding/dependency controls, not a general falsity classifier or the paper's original 42 mutants, and add no hardware/model/paper result.
